subject: Routing: quickstart docs lead — schedule technical demo with Buildly
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-04-17T14:06:00Z
Subject: Quickstart lead routed to you — Buildly (developer intent)

Camila,

A new self-serve signup completed the docs quickstart path and signaled developer intent — Buildly (contact: Alex Morales). Routing to you for SDR outreach + technical demo handoff. Key notes from the intake form: they tried the sandbox with a short prompt set, saw latency variance on 4k contexts, and want a short deep-dive on model routing and KV caching.

Suggested next steps:
- Quick outreach to confirm attendees and availability
- Propose a 30-min technical demo with an engineer (mateo_alvarez) to show routing and cache behavior
- Share a short agenda and MAP draft before the call

I added mateo on cc for availability. Let me know if you want assistance with pricing/enterprise hooks — happy to join.

Thanks,
Vivek
Sr. SDR Ops | Redwood Inference
From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
To: Alex Morales <alex@buildly.com>, Jordan Li <jordan@buildly.com>
Cc: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-04-17T15:18:00Z
Subject: Re: Quickstart lead routed to you — Buildly (developer intent)

Hi Alex / Jordan —

Thanks for trying the quickstart and flagging the latency behavior. I’m Camila on the SDR team — we try to make the technical handoff seamless. Mateo (cc) is our engineer who will run the demo.

Would one of these windows work for a 30-minute technical walkthrough next week?
- Tue 2028-04-18 16:00–16:30 PDT
- Wed 2028-04-19 09:00–09:30 PDT
- Thu 2028-04-19 13:00–13:30 PDT

If none of those fit, share a couple of times and we’ll adjust. Agenda (short):
1) Quick context (5 min) — what you tried in the quickstart
2) Live demo (15 min) — routing, batching, KV cache behavior on long contexts
3) Q&A + next steps (10 min) — MAP and trial plan

I’ve attached a one-pager agenda and a draft MAP to keep things focused. I’ll also drop a Cal link if you prefer to pick a slot: https://cal.com/redwood/demo/buildly

Thanks — Camila
Camila Reyes
Account Executive, Developer GTM | Redwood Inference
attachments: quickstart-demo-agenda.pdf (1 page), mutual-action-plan-buildly.docx (draft)
From: Alex Morales <alex@buildly.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Li <jordan@buildly.com>
Date: 2028-04-17T20:12:00Z
Subject: Re: Quickstart lead routed to you — Buildly (developer intent)

Hi Camila —

Thanks for the quick reply. We can do Tue 2028-04-18 16:00 PDT. Attendees: myself (Alex, backend lead) and Jordan (platform engineer).

Couple of quick asks so Mateo can prepare:
- Can you show KV cache effects on a ~6k token context? We’ve got prompt concatenation that expands in production.
- Any notes on model fallback behavior when a node is busy (we saw a fallback to a smaller variant).

I attached a calendar invite (stub) to lock the slot.

Best,
Alex
Backend Lead, Buildly Inc.
attachments: buildly-demo-invite.ics (invite stub)
From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Morales <alex@buildly.com>, Jordan Li <jordan@buildly.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-04-17T21:05:00Z
Subject: Fwd: Quickstart lead routed to you — Buildly (developer intent) — confirmed 4/18 16:00 PDT

Mateo — forwarding confirmed slot. Quick context for the demo (30 min):
- Buildly tried our quickstart, saw latency variance at longer contexts (~6k tokens).
- Primary asks: show KV cache behavior, routing/fallback explanation, and recommended config to stabilize latency.

Proposed runbook for the 30-min call:
- 0–5 min: intros & quickstart notes (Alex / Jordan)
- 5–20 min: live demo — reproduce quickstart prompt pattern, show KV cache and routing (you can use the sandbox model we both have access to)
- 20–30 min: Q&A + next steps (MAP ownership, potential Dedicated trial slot)

Attachments: buildly-demo-invite.ics (attached by Alex), quickstart-demo-agenda.pdf, mutual-action-plan-buildly.docx

If you want, I can take the first 5 minutes for intros and hand it to you. Please confirm availability and whether you need any extra environment setup.

Thanks — Camila
Camila Reyes | Account Executive, Developer GTM
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Morales <alex@buildly.com>, Jordan Li <jordan@buildly.com>
Date: 2028-04-18T08:30:00Z
Subject: Re: Fwd: Quickstart lead routed to you — confirmed 4/18 16:00 PDT

Camila / Alex —

I’m available for Tue 4/18 16:00 PDT and will take the demo. I’ll prep a short repro that pushes ~6k tokens using a concatenated prompt and show KV cache hit/miss behavior; I’ll also demonstrate the fallback path and how we choose compatible model variants under load.

Requests: if you can confirm the sample prompt set (or paste a 2–3 example prompts) before EOD today I’ll bake them into the repro. I’ll share the sandbox session link and a short recording after the call.

See you on Tuesday — Mateo
Mateo Alvarez
Software Engineer, Serving Runtime | Redwood Inference
